traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Olneya (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.82 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 2 records in 2 sources); trunks 0.82, branches 0.73. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.note: Jepson eFlora's account of desert ironwood, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): flower papilionaceous, the wings purple-pink, the banner and keel yellow-white to pink or purple; stamens 10, 9 fused and 1 free.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams (vol. 2, 1944, p. 562), genus Olneya (one species): grey-hairy spiny trees with pinnate or odd-pinnate leaves and obsolete stipules; racemes axillary; calyx bell-shaped, 5-lobed; standard rounded, reflexed, with two calluses at its base; wings sickle-shaped; keel broadly crescent-shaped; stamens 10, nine joined and one free; pod rather swollen, two-valved, bumpy over the seeds.
